summary: Tested new Admin Courses tab (list, inline title edit + persistence + revert, Preview & Free Sessions modal with idempotent toggle), CourseDetailsPage new dual hero CTAs (Enrol Now + Start a free session with scroll behavior), guest paywall dynamic /enroll/{courseId} href, and backend regression for course_id on /api/free-session[/s] plus admin /api/admin/courses[/preview-sessions]. All 5 pytest tests pass. All 12 UI checks pass. Free-trial session set (2 ids) preserved. Course title reverted to original. One minor cosmetic bug found in paywall header count.

ui_bugs.issue: Paywall header reads '3 FREE SESSIONS COMPLETED' after finishing 2 free sessions. completedCount is computed as freeSessions.filter(done).length + 1 which double-counts the just-finished current session (it is already in the done list by the time PaywallCTA renders). Should just be freeSessions.filter(done).length (== 2).

action_items: (LOW/optional) Fix paywall completedCount off-by-one so header shows '2 FREE SESSIONS COMPLETED' instead of 3. Change `freeSessions.filter((s) => getDoneList().includes(s.id)).length + 1` to `freeSessions.filter((s) => getDoneList().includes(s.id)).length` in the paywall render at GuestSessionPage.jsx ~line 583.
critical_code_review_comments: GuestSessionPage.jsx line 583: completedCount arithmetic adds +1 unnecessarily; the current session is already added to vv_guest_done inside advancePhase (markSessionDone) before setShowPaywall is called, so filtering already returns the correct count.
CoursesTab.jsx: input at line 175 has no explicit type attribute; while it defaults to text, adding type="text" avoids selector footguns for tests. Not a blocker.

rca of the issue: No critical issues. The minor paywall header count bug: in GuestSessionPage.jsx PaywallCTA prop `completedCount` receives `freeSessions.filter((s) => getDoneList().includes(s.id)).length + 1`, but by the time showPaywall is true the current session id has already been pushed into vv_guest_done via markSessionDone() inside advancePhase. The filter therefore already returns 2, and adding +1 renders '3 FREE SESSIONS COMPLETED'. Fix: drop the `+ 1`.
